Position Overview
Details of the Division and Team
Transactional FX is a high-profile joint venture between the Corporate Bank (CB) and Investment Bank (IB). Transactional FX team is responsible for delivering one of the fastest growing revenue streams in CB & IB by providing market leading FX workflow solutions to clients. Transactional FX leverages the firm’s position as a market leader in CB and offers variety of standard and bespoke FX solutions to solve for client’s FX workflow needs.
What We Will Offer You
A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.
You can expect:
Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members
Your Key Responsibilities
The role focuses on the end-to-end implementation process of TFX solutions on both the CB and the IB side of the setup. The implementation/project manager has full responsibility for the end-to-end execution of FX4Cash implementation deals for CB clients. The deals may include customized client business requirements, testing coordination, training/coaching (internally and externally) and the setup of highly technical products in multiple phases. In addition, support might need to be provided to other implementation responsibilities, e.g., client migration projects.
In addition to this, role requires candidate to be able to understand business economics and drive commercial initiatives, track business performance, run analytical models to find opportunities, perform product management & risk control activities.
The TFX Specialist role Relationship and Transaction Management (RTM) includes the following
Manages implementation pipelines and progress efficiently and effectively. At the same time, communicates and conducts regular status reviews/meetings and ensures that the implementation meets the agreed milestones and client’s expectation.
Manages migration projects incl communication with stakeholders.
Establish, develop and cultivate relationships between the various stakeholders (implementations, support groups, sales, PSS)
Identifies and manages/resolves potential issues and risks.
Ability to effectively interface with people at multiple levels in the organization.
Responsible that all task deliverables are met in a timely fashion.
Create and manage project plans for high value deals
Produce management reporting and performance tracking, business KPI’s
Ability to manage more than one project and multiple delivery dates at a time.
Become the Center of Competence for Transactional FX.
Give assistance and support on any question/queries on Implementation process.
Work effectively in a matrix environment in a global organization.
Comply with all DB policies and procedures
Your Skills And Experience
Analytical and process driven with structured work ethics
Ability to understand complex technology structures to be able to understand various systems and set ups involved. Experience in FIX API and REST API implementation is a plus.
Excellent office skills to include experience with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
Good conceptual grasp of FX payments, pricing and market terminology
Knowledge of Corporate cash management and general correspondence banking
Knowledge and experience in analytical tools like Tableau would be added advantage
Experience in Implementation or operations would be added advantage
Strong customer orientation and service vision with sense of urgency
Ability to work independently, as well as in a team environment, prioritizes multiple tasks, and meets strict deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal, communication skills and problem-solving skills
Experience of working in KPI-driven, performance-metric focused, timeliness and quality focused environment
Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs
How We’ll Support You
Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
Training and development to help you excel in your career
About Us And Our Teams
Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. Click here to see what we do.
Deutsche Bank & Diversity
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

About The Opportunity
Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 30 November 2026
Job Description
Title Senior Technical Consultant
Department Enterprise Platforms - Canada Services
Location Dalian
Reports To Head of Canada Services
Level Grade 6
We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
About Your Team
Enterprise Platforms - Canada Services provides technology delivery, engineering and operational support to Fidelity Clearing Canada (FCC). The team partners closely with FCC Technology, Product, Business and Operations to deliver, maintain and modernize business-critical platforms and services for external clients and internal business lines.
About Your Role
As Senior Technical Consultant, you will provide senior hands-on technical expertise for the maintenance, support and modernization of .NET-based trading systems within Enterprise Platforms - Canada Services. You will work across legacy application assessment, solution architecture, software engineering and technical delivery, helping the team understand existing codebases, reduce technology risk and define pragmatic modernization paths. A key part of the role will be to leverage AI-enabled engineering and code analysis tools, alongside traditional engineering practices, to accelerate codebase understanding, identify risks and dependencies, support refactoring and remediation, and help define and implement the target modernization approach. You will work closely with Technical Architecture, Product, Business, Operations, Information Security, engineering and vendor teams across FCC and FIL to translate business and operational requirements into robust technical solutions. The role requires strong hands-on .NET engineering capability combined with solution architecture and design skills, with responsibility spanning application maintenance, production support, refactoring, modernization, integration, technical debt reduction and engineering quality. Finance, trading system, capital-markets or investment domain knowledge is a plus.
What You Will Do
Provide senior hands-on technical leadership for the assessment, maintenance, enhancement and modernization of .NET-based trading applications and supporting services.
Analyse existing and legacy codebases, application architecture, dependencies and integrations to identify technical risks, maintainability concerns, end-of-life components and modernization opportunities, using AI-enabled code analysis tools where appropriate to accelerate and deepen the assessment.
Design and implement robust solutions using C#, .NET/.NET Core, ASP.NET, RESTful APIs, SQL and related Microsoft technologies, applying appropriate architecture and integration patterns.
Define and implement pragmatic modernization and refactoring approaches that improve maintainability, reliability, security and scalability while protecting continuity of critical business services, leveraging AI-assisted engineering to accelerate remediation where appropriate.
Provide solution architecture and detailed technical design, including application components, APIs, integrations, data flows, deployment patterns and non-functional requirements.
Support application maintenance and Level 3 production support, including incident investigation, root-cause analysis, defect remediation, performance troubleshooting and application upgrades.
Promote strong engineering practices covering automated testing, code quality, secure coding, CI/CD, observability, documentation, operational readiness and technical debt management, ensuring AI-generated recommendations and code are appropriately reviewed and validated.
Work closely with architecture, business, product, operations, security, infrastructure and vendor teams to understand requirements, evaluate solution options and coordinate delivery dependencies.
Provide technical estimation, implementation planning and clear communication of technical risks, trade-offs, dependencies and remediation priorities to Canada Services and FCC stakeholders.
Leverage AI-enabled engineering tools to accelerate code understanding, dependency and risk analysis, refactoring, modernization, testing and documentation, while applying strong technical judgement and appropriate architecture, security, quality and governance controls.
About You
You bring extensive hands-on software engineering experience with strong expertise in C# and the Microsoft .NET technology stack, including development, maintenance and modernization of complex enterprise applications. You have demonstrated solution architecture and technical design capability and can move comfortably between architecture-level decisions and hands-on code analysis and implementation. You have experience assessing legacy applications, refactoring complex codebases, managing technical debt and remediating obsolete or end-of-life technologies. You understand APIs and integration patterns, SQL and relational databases, secure software development, automated testing, CI/CD and production support for business-critical systems. You are comfortable leveraging AI-enabled software engineering tools for code analysis, codebase understanding, refactoring, testing, documentation and modernization, while critically validating AI-generated outputs and applying appropriate security, architecture and engineering controls. You can troubleshoot complex technical issues, communicate design decisions and trade-offs clearly, and work effectively across distributed business, technology and vendor teams. Experience with AI-assisted software engineering is highly desirable. Finance or financial-services domain knowledge, particularly experience with trading systems, capital markets or investment platforms, is a plus.
Feel rewarded
For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

Principal Responsibilities
Pillar 1: Model Hosting & Inference Optimization
Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable model hosting systems to support large-scale deployment of AI models (LLMs, embedding models, STT/TTS, etc.) across diverse hardware platforms.
Develop and implement inference optimization strategies to achieve low latency, high throughput, and cost-efficiency, including model quantization, KV cache optimization, and dynamic batch processing / Continuous Batching.
Evaluate, integrate, and customize state-of-the-art inference frameworks (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, etc.) to optimize model performance on target hardware.
Monitor and maintain inference system health, track key performance metrics (latency, throughput, TTFT, memory usage, availability), and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks or deployment issues.
Collaborate with hardware teams to leverage hardware-specific and optimize hosting infrastructure for maximum resource utilization.
Ensure model hosting systems comply with reliability, scalability, and security standards, supporting high-availability production workloads.
Pillar 2: Model Fine-Tuning Pipeline Development
Design and build end-to-end, scalable model fine-tuning pipelines to support domain-specific adaptation of pre-trained using custom, domain-specified datasets.
Collaborate with data scientists and domain experts to understand domain requirements, define fine-tuning objectives, and validate fine-tuned model performance against domain-specific metrics.
Integrate fine-tuned models into the existing hosting and inference infrastructure, ensuring smooth handoff from fine-tuning to deployment.
Pillar 3: Team Management & Delivery Ownership
Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team: hiring, coaching, performance management, and fostering an inclusive, collaborative culture.
Own delivery outcomes end-to-end, including roadmap planning, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and execution against timelines and quality standards.

The Opportunity
The CTO team is seeking a visionary, hands-on engineering leader to design, build, and scale HSBC Agent Platform as a core capability within the Group AI Platform. This role will deliver secure, reusable and high-performance platform services that enables team across the bank to build, deploy and operate agentic and generative AI solutions consistently, overing orchestration, tool integration, memory, evaluation and governance-by-design. You’ll set the technical direction, drive reliability and adoption at scale and ensure the platform meets enterprise standard for performance, resilience, security and controls.
What You’ll Do
Define the long-term technical vision and roadmap for the Agent platform in collaboration with product management team
Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of a robust, scalable, and high-performance Agent platform
Stay at the cutting edge of AI and agent movement in the industry, and adapt the agent platform to leverage the technical evolving in the industry
Work closely with technology teams across business lines to understand their requirements and ensure the platform empowers them to build agents efficiently
Integrate agent platform as part of the Group AI Platform which spans on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure
Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices
Implement observability, reliability, and performance optimizations for agent platform in production
Ensure compliance to architecture principle, technical standards, security requirements and software development life cycle controls
Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related subject area
15+ of experience in developing and implementing software solutions, with 5+ years in technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience in design and development of agentic AI solutions
Proven and deep experience in designing, building, and delivering a large-scale Agent platform
Deep understanding of the agent paradigm, including agent planning, short-term and long-term memory, tool use, agent orchestration and agent evaluation
Experience with high code and low code agent platform
Strong experience in designing and building scalable and resilient platform
Proven ability in building and managing high performing teams of AI SME and full stack engineers
Solid hands-on development skills in programming language such as Java, Python, and CI/CD tools, automation testing, and observability
Proficiency in effective stakeholder management, and capable of effectively articulating AI capabilities, and influencing both business and technology leaders
Experience working in Agile development teams with excellent collaboration skills

Excellent understanding of enterprise technology practices (including open-source engineering approaches).

Clear communication and ability to translate complexity into plain language.

Architecture and platform designs that meet non‑functional requirements (scalability, resiliency, security).

Key Responsibilities
This role could be based in China or Hong Kong. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you select a country where the role is based.
Strategy
Set CPM Markets’ global funding and resource optimisation strategy, including delivery of the CFD mandate, to improve FM revenues and returns within funding, liquidity and regulatory constraints.
Develop CPM Markets’ CFD function as FM’s central funding utility, with clear priorities, targets, management information and governance.
Shape FM’s Funds Transfer Pricing policy and framework with Treasury, Finance and Markets, aligning funding, liquidity and balance-sheet costs with business decisions.
Translate capital, liquidity and margin developments into strategic priorities, management information and system requirements for FM and CIB.
Own the Client Term Deposits (CTD) product strategy and roadmap, aligning its proposition with FM priorities and Treasury Markets’ funding and liquidity requirements.
Business
Lead FM funding and regulatory-cost (LCR/ NSFR) management, balancing growth, profitability and resource constraints.
Partner with Repo and Structuring to raise cash through money markets, ABCP and structured notes, minimising funding and regulatory P&L drag.
Align Sales, Trading, CPM, Treasury, Finance and governance forums on FM funding, liquidity, Corporate Plan and balance-sheet priorities.
Partner with Sales to deliver the CTD strategy and commercial agenda, originating and executing solutions that meet Treasury Markets’ funding and stress liquidity needs.
Processes
Manage FM’s daily cash funding and leverage requirements within approved limits.
Monitor funding costs, liquidity usage and regulatory constraints, escalating emerging risks and recommending appropriate mitigation.
Mark CFD asset and liability funding curves and maintain the funding pipeline.
Manage FM intragroup exposures within approved limits.
Execute funding, inventory and collateral optimisation to reduce regulatory and P&L drag and redeploy leverage to higher-returning assets.
Implement regulatory and policy changes through fit-for-purpose processes, management information and systems.
Provide guidance to Product Management and Technology on the CTD roadmap, enhancing the product experience and enabling seamless delivery for Sales.
People & Talent
Set clear expectations and foster a collaborative, accountable and inclusive culture.
Communicate CPM Markets’ vision, CFD priorities and progress clearly.
Build team capability through coaching, knowledge-sharing and continuous improvement.
Risk Management
Identify and manage the principal risks arising from FM funding and resource optimisation.
Operate within the dealer mandate, risk appetite, limits and applicable policies.
Escalate material risks and control issues promptly and complete required attestations and training.
Manage risk and P&L of a trading book
Governance
Assess governance and control effectiveness and oversee remediation.
Discharge responsibilities in line with regulatory obligations and Group standards.
Provide effective challenge, speak up on breaches and engage openly with regulators and control functions.
Skills And Experience
Dealing experience in financial instruments e.g. FX swaps, interest rate swaps
Competency in analysing market risk and PNL on trading positions
Knowledge and understanding of key balance sheet metrics (LCR, NSFR, leverage ratio, RWA etc)
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline.
CFA, FRM, CPA or similar professional qualification would be advantageous but not mandatory.
Experience in Markets, Treasury, ALM, Funding, Liquidity Management, Product Control, Market Risk, or Financial Resource Management.
Exposure to trading products such as: FX swaps, Money Markets, Repo / Reverse Repo, Bonds, Structured Deposits and Securities Financing Transactions
About Standard Chartered
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Together We
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
What We Offer
In line with our Fair Pay Charter,
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Proactively engage with Personal Clients hidden affluent and advise to approach bank with complex investment needs;
Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties;
Ensure compliance of Management Manual, Operating Manuals and Bank’s laid down knowledge of the various products offered by all departments;
Learn and understand all relevant regulations and internal Risk & Compliance policies and procedures;
Keep updated on the events in the financial industry;
Participate actively in training programs, meetings, briefings organized by the bank and ensure skills & knowledge acquired is applied to daily work;
Ensure timeliness & managing customer’s complaint;
主要工作职责/挑战：
理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。
实现领导安排的各个产品的业绩指标；
维护与客户的关系并提供卓越的客户服务以确保满足客户需求；
通过扩大现有客户的投资组合加强客户与我行的关系；
积极参与优先理财/其它银行营销项目，以获取新客户。另外，向现有客户进行交叉销售；
主动发现具有“优先理财”资质的个人理财客户, 并发掘其投资理财需求；
负责实施各项反洗钱的需求并且确保符合反洗钱的合规要求；
遵循银行的管理手册，操作手册和所有部门相关产品的既定政策；
学习并了解一切相关条例以及内部风险与合规的政策与程序；
保持对金融行业相关动向的敏感；
积极参与银行组织的培训项目，会议和简报会，并保证将学习到的技能和知识运用到日常工作中；
确保客户投诉的时效与管理；

Responsibilities that are related to the development and implementation of a strategy, for example, Awareness and understanding of the Group’s business strategy and model appropriate to the role.
Business
Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates
Processes
Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process.
People & Talent
Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.
